title: Ansible: A Build Host From Nothing, Twice, With Secrets From Vault
description: Compose roles into one playbook that turns a bare host into a working Jenkins, prove the second run changes nothing, take the admin password from Vault instead of the repository, and write a verify play that fails loudly when something is missing.

steps.title: The second run should say nothing
The password that is not in the repository
A verify playbook that fails loudly
